plan.title: Edit event-specific terms for an RFP event

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow specified by the case.
Set the event type to RFQ as required before configuring the template.
Provide the mandatory event title so the create flow is valid.
Choose the first available RFQ template so the product sheet and event terms controls are available.
Add the requested CYLINDER line item and enter the requested quantity.
Attempt to set the requested delivery location on the first product row.
Open the event Terms & Conditions interface.
Confirm that the event-specific terms editing option is available.
